item.title: PromeFTP 1.1.1
item.description:
Review, queue, and retry SFTP transfers

Compare folders before copying, track transfers while you browse, and resolve file conflicts without holding up transfers on other connections.

  • Keep working while files transfer
    Use the Transfers drawer for progress, error details, and pause, cancel, or retry controls. Comparison transfers appear as a group.
  • Choose exactly what to copy
    Compare local and remote folders or two remote folders. Select files, expand size and modification details, and stop validation before jobs are queued.
  • Catch changes before copying
    PromeFTP checks for path name collisions and rechecks the selected files against the preview. Files found only at the destination are preserved.
  • Find folders and recover interrupted work
    Edit and reorder path favorites. Reopen the matching SFTP connection to retry a failed file-menu transfer.

Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon. Remote Keep Both requires the server's OpenSSH hard-link extension.
